verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an accounts-payable Bills API for creating and managing vendor invoices, and positions Spend as automating accounts payable, so the invoice side of the story has first-party support. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic purchase-order matching, GL coding, or approval routing of bills to payment. Missing for 10: PO matching, automatic invoice coding, approval and payment routing workflow, any AI or automated extraction, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment

citations.quote: The Bills API lets you create and manage invoices received from vendors for goods or services.
Control, automate, and reconcile global company spend across expenses and accounts payable.
